description: This file defines the LifecycleInterfaceConnector class, which manages lifecycle operations for applications, including launching, closing, terminating, and handling app state changes. It also includes an internal NotificationHandler class for event notifications related to app lifecycle state changes.

classes.name: LifecycleInterfaceConnector
classes.description: Manages application lifecycle operations and event notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: Internal class implementing the ILifecycleManagerState::INotification interface to handle lifecycle state change notifications.

methods.name: createLifecycleManagerRemoteObject
methods.description: Creates the remote object for managing application lifecycle.

methods.name: releaseLifecycleManagerRemoteObject
methods.description: Releases the remote lifecycle manager object.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an application with specified parameters.

methods.name: preLoadApp
methods.description: Preloads an application with given arguments.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent to the specified application.

methods.name: getLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of loaded applications.

methods.name: OnAppLifecycleStateChanged
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle state change events.

methods.name: mapAppLifecycleState
methods.description: Maps internal lifecycle states to external app lifecycle states.

methods.name: GetAppInstanceId
methods.description: Retrieves the application instance ID for a given app.

methods.name: isAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if an application is loaded.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.
